title: A Little Rabbit in the Orchard

paragraphs.text: Look at the apple orchard. It is big and green. There are many apple trees. The apples are red and green.
paragraphs.translation: 看这个苹果园。它又大又绿。那里有很多苹果树。苹果有红的，也有绿的。

paragraphs.text: A little rabbit lives here. It has two long ears. It likes red apples. It can jump very high.
paragraphs.translation: 一只小兔子住在这里。它有两只长长的耳朵。它喜欢红苹果。它能跳得很高。

paragraphs.text: My brother and I come. We have a big basket. The rabbit is not shy. It sits near our basket.
paragraphs.translation: 我和哥哥来了。我们有一个大篮子。这只兔子不怕生。它坐在我们的篮子旁边。

paragraphs.text: My brother picks a red apple. The apple is big and sweet. He puts it in the basket. The rabbit looks at us.
paragraphs.translation: 哥哥摘了一个红苹果。这个苹果又大又甜。他把它放进篮子里。兔子看着我们。

paragraphs.text: I give it a small apple. It eats the apple fast. Then it runs away. We say goodbye to it.
paragraphs.translation: 我给了它一个小苹果。它很快就把苹果吃掉了。然后它跑开了。我们跟它说再见。

paragraphs.text: We go home with apples. Mom makes apple juice. We are all happy today.
paragraphs.translation: 我们带着苹果回家了。妈妈做了苹果汁。我们今天都很开心。

quiz.question: What does the little rabbit like?
quiz.audioText: What does the little rabbit like?
The apples are red and green.
